## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2f621a589699fc007e1194d01e6efc728b1a924b`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/resolveBulkActions.ts, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/resolveLegacyRowActions.ts, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/undeclaredActionNames.ts, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridActionsColumn.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-grid/demo/bulk-actions.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/{actionsColumnAndChips-12708,bulkActionMembers-8071,bulkActionRefresh,bulkActionsSpecKey,gridPagerSelectionMembers-8071,legacyRowActionDispatch,objectBulkActionDispatch,rowCrudEffectiveOps}.test.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/{resolveBulkActions,resolveLegacyRowActions}.test.ts + packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts (the sentence at ~:406), packages/lint/src/validate-action-name-refs.ts (`action-name-undefined`), ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx (the published entry, unchanged), ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/RowActionMenu.tsx (`rowActions` prop, `planRowActionMenu`), ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridRowLoad.ts (`setObjectSchema`), ui/packages/core/src/utils/record-source.ts (`resolveRecordSourceObjectName`), ui/packages/core/src/utils/column-identity.ts and ui/packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts (the two dev-gate idioms), ui/apps/console/index.html (the `window.process` shim) and ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts (`define`), ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx (grid delegation ~:4403-4504, non-grid bulk bar ~:2515, ~:7333), ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx (~:778-790), examples/app-crm/src/views/lead.view.ts. Prose read only for ② and code-match: README.md, the changeset.

Inputs: card #30169 (body and every comment; ruling 6651753071 = option C, read verbatim), PR #30387 body, file list, net diff `origin/main...origin/claude/project-thread-8y2k2m` (18 files, +429/-127), the check-runs on the head. The dispatch order and the seat's own conclusions were not inputs.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set and surface changes the diff implies, each judged against the ruling and the cited code:

1. **A bare `bulkActions` name with no match in the served `objectDef.actions` draws no selection-bar button and is never dispatched** (`resolveBulkActions.ts` :488-500; `ObjectGrid.tsx` :1290-1295, `effectiveBulkActions` is now `keptDeleteAction` alone). Right: this is ruling C's first sentence and the spec's own ("names an action the object declares", `bulk-action.zod.ts` :406); lint `action-name-undefined` already refuses the name at authoring with severity error. A misspelling, a handler-only name and an action a disabled package withholds (absent from the served object by #28877) all fall under it, and the code cannot tell them apart, which is exactly what C accepted.
2. **A bare legacy `rowActions` name with no match draws no row-menu entry** (`resolveLegacyRowActions.ts` :93-100; `objectGridActionsColumn.tsx` drops the `customRowActions` input, `hasRowActions` :63 no longer counts bare names, the plan and the menu props no longer receive `rowActions`). Right: the ruling extends the rule to this fold. The Actions column therefore no longer appears for a list whose only row action is an undeclared name (12708 fixture repaired accordingly). Right.
3. **A declared name is promoted exactly as before** (label, icon, params, `visible`, `requiredPermissions`; the `claimed` set still lets an authored `bulkActionDefs` / host `rowActionDefs` twin win and a repeated name fold once). Right; unchanged lines.
4. **`'delete'` keeps its own path**: filtered out before the fold (`legacyBulkNames` :1261), kept in `keptDeleteAction`, routed by `dispatchBulkAction` :1981 to `onBulkDelete` or to the runner by name; the implicit bulk-delete affordance is unchanged; `'edit'`/`'delete'` in `rowActions` still select the native entries ahead of the fold (:1005). Right, as the ruling required ("untouched").
5. **Auto-enabled multi-select** (`hasBulkActions` :1296 → `selectionMode = 'multiple'`): a list whose `bulkActions` carries only undeclared names no longer turns checkboxes on, and one with a declared name turns them on only once the object schema has landed (the 8071 pager fixture now waits). Right: a consequence of C, and the bar it would have served draws nothing.
6. **Return-shape rename `unresolved` → `undeclared`** on both resolvers, and the `customRowActions` input removed from `resolveObjectGridActionsColumn`: none of the three is reachable from `src/index.tsx` (read on the head; the entry is byte-identical to `main`), so nothing published moves. Right.
7. **`undeclaredActionNames.ts` is new and NOT exported from the entry** (the only importer is `ObjectGrid.tsx` :76). `RowActionMenu` and `RowActionMenuProps` stay exported with their pre-existing `rowActions?: string[]` prop and the plan's `legacy` arm; `ObjectGrid` simply no longer feeds it. So the published surface of `@object-ui/plugin-grid` neither grows nor shrinks: nothing is widened, one rendering tolerance is withdrawn. **`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is the right declaration**; `yes` would be wrong.
8. **The dev-only warning** (`useUndeclaredActionNamesWarning`): one `console.warn` per fold per distinct list, keyed on the names' values, held until `objectSchema != null || !schema.objectName`, called in hook order before the first early return (:1305-1310 against :1591). The mechanism is right in the Console grid path (ListView's `baseProps` :4403 always hands the node `objectName`, and `objectGridRowLoad.ts` :156 sets `objectSchema` on the first load). Two edge shapes are judged under ④ (should-fix).
9. **Demo and README**: the handler-only `legacy_only_handler` / `export` / `view` examples are gone and replaced by a declared name; the README's rule paragraph matches the code. One nit: the sentence "`'edit'` and `'delete'` are the built-in exceptions" sits under *Row Actions* and is right there; for `bulkActions` only `'delete'` is built in (an `'edit'` in `bulkActions` is now dropped and warned). Prose only; no action required.
10. **Tests**: the three old pins of the tolerance (8071 row 3, "keeps an unresolvable name…", "leaves a name with no declared action…") flip to substantive assertions with the trigger named in the test; both resolver unit files flip; the new describe pins withheld (no button, no humanized text, one warning naming it and not the sibling) and served (the action's own label, no warning); five stand-in fixtures now declare the action they name; `bulkActionRefresh` reaches the by-name branch through the canonical `'delete'` with no `onBulkDelete`, which is the one by-name path the ruling keeps. Right. The ablation legs are the dev's report and were not re-run here; the pins they name are present in the tree.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/30169-undeclared-bulk-action-name-draws-nothing.md`: `'@object-ui/plugin-grid': minor`. The only package whose published behaviour moves is plugin-grid (`@object-ui/core`, `plugin-list`, `app-shell`, `packages/spec` untouched); `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` takes at least `minor` on that package. Matches.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` on the PR body and in the changeset, same arm, same reasoning (the spec sentence and `action-name-undefined`). Matches the tree (① item 7). `(narrowing)` is BREAKING: the changeset carries the **BREAKING** banner, the Before/Now/Unchanged account, the ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` and a prose remedy (declare the action or remove the name; a withheld action needs nothing). The gates that read these (`Check Changeset`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, which carries `check:adr-0087-registration`) are green on this head.
- `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`: the spec text is unchanged, but what an author's written bare name does is tightened to the spec's own requirement; `narrowed` is the conservative reading ("a requirement tightened") and matches the dispatch's own declaration. Accepted. `Skills-docs: none owed` matches what I can read: no `skills/**` or `content/docs/ui/**` example in the diff's reach names a handler-only bulk or row action.
- No `packages/spec` change, so no generated artifact is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

Every flag in the os-dev-report (card comment 6654001061) and the earlier report (6642981552):

- **Open question A/B/C** (6642981552): answered by ruling 6651753071, option C; the tree executes C and not A (no `ActionRunner` change) nor B (no `/meta/action` read). Closed.
- **Deviation 1** (no handler-only consumer in-tree): read it myself on the head — every non-test `bulkActions` / `rowActions` string under `examples/`, `ui/apps/`, `ui/packages/` names a declared action; the demo was the one exception and is changed here. Holds.
- **Deviation 2** (`bulkActionRefresh` re-targeted to `'delete'` with no `onBulkDelete`): the pinned behaviour (refresh + selection reset after a string action) is still reached, through the one by-name path the ruling keeps. Accepted.
- **Deviation 3** (row-menu drop not ablated as one line): the drop is pinned directly by `legacyRowActionDispatch` (`row-action-crm_only_handler` absent while the declared sibling draws), which is a pin of the structural removal, not only of the warning. Accepted.
- **Deviation 4** (whole `plugin-grid` directory run once under the lock, 12m23s): a process deviation against the order, reported; not a tree defect. Noted for the seat.
- **Deviation 5** (first two commits without the trailer pair; history not rewritten): reporting deviation; not a tree defect. Noted.
- **Deviation 6** (PR footer form, no assignee/labels): hand-off state; not a tree defect.
- **Out-of-scope 1 — plugin-list `ListView`'s non-grid bulk bar** (`ListView.tsx` :7333-7375) draws every `permittedBulkActions` member by `tActionLabel(action)` with no resolution against the object's actions. Read on the head and confirmed. **Judgment: a follow-up card, not a must-fix here.** Reasons: (a) the ruling's execution list names only the plugin-grid resolvers, their pins, demo and README, and the dispatch's file surface is `ui/packages/plugin-grid/**`; (b) the card's reproduced defect is the grid's bar (Leads → All Leads is a grid view), and the grid path is where ListView delegates (`batchActions: schema.bulkActions`, :4504); (c) that bar is a different mechanism altogether: it has no promotion step even for declared names and dispatches by bare string through `props.onBulkAction`, a runtime slot that has no in-repo provider (`types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` :2421 says so), so bringing it under the rule means first deciding what that bar dispatches to, which is its own ruling. The changeset is scoped to `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, so its "a list's selection bar" reads as the grid's. The seat must file the card (class b, carrier seat, dedupe words given in the report) rather than let the finding live only in this thread.
- **Out-of-scope 2** (`content/docs/frontend/` page not touched): observation; the pages in reach already show declared names. Accepted.
- **Main-red note from the brief**: `Lint UI` on this head is judged on its own step, see the gate line below.

### ④ Design judgment

Per scope file, against the ruling and the cited code; each break attempt named.

- **`resolveBulkActions.ts`** — holds. A declared-name collision with an authored def: `claimed` keeps the authored def and reports nothing (right, not undeclared). A declared action named `delete`: never reaches this fold (filtered at :1261), so it cannot be reported as undeclared and the `onBulkDelete` route is unchanged. A withheld package's action: absent from the served array, reported once. Header rewritten to state the rule and its two sources. No finding.
- **`resolveLegacyRowActions.ts`** — holds. Same collision reasoning against host `rowActionDefs`; a repeated undeclared name reported once (new pin). The pre-existing "tolerates a missing object schema" row still returns the name as `undeclared`, which is why the grid gates the warning on readiness. No finding.
- **`ObjectGrid.tsx`** — the drop holds (① 1, 4, 5). Hook order holds. Two should-fixes on the warning's readiness gate, both in `undeclaredNamesReady` (:1299):
  - **should-fix (a)**: it reads `schema.objectName`, while the grid's object is `objectName = resolveRecordSourceObjectName(schema, dataConfig) ?? schema.objectName` (:811). A grid whose object arrives only through `data: { provider: 'object', object }` with no top-level `objectName` (a shape this file's own inline-edit note calls out, and the shape `examples/app-crm/src/views/lead.view.ts` writes) reads `ready` as true on the first render, before the schema has landed, so every bare name is reported as undeclared once, with a "no objectName" address, and the author is told to declare an action that is declared. Reach: standalone SDUI grids only; the Console path hands `objectName` down (`ListView.tsx` :4403). Remedy: key readiness on the resolved `objectName`, and use it for the address.
  - **should-fix (b)**: with an `objectName` and no `dataSource.getObjectSchema` (an inline-data grid, or a schema fetch that failed) `ready` never flips, so the names are dropped silently, which is the half the ruling asked to keep audible. Remedy: mirror `objectTypesPending` (:836): ready when there is nothing to wait for, i.e. `objectSchema != null || !(objectName && typeof dataSource?.getObjectSchema === 'function')`.
- **`undeclaredActionNames.ts`** — the message is complete (key, block, names, prescription) and `JSON.stringify` keying makes the effect fire once per distinct list, not per render. Two should-fixes:
  - **should-fix (c) production gate**: `isDevelopment()` reads `(globalThis).process?.env?.NODE_ENV !== 'production'`. That is `@object-ui/core`'s idiom (`column-identity.ts` :110, `reference-keys.ts`, `dashboard-filters.ts`, `actionKeys.ts`, `errors/index.ts`), so the module is consistent with the tree, but in the Console it does not gate: `ui/apps/console/index.html` :187 installs `window.process = { env: { NODE_ENV: 'development' } }` unconditionally, and a split optional chain is not a token the bundler replaces (the Console's `define` of `'process.env'` reaches only the literal spelling). So a production Console logs the warning too. The tree's other idiom, the bundler-replaced literal `process.env.NODE_ENV` with a module-scoped `declare const process` (`fields/resolveActionParams.ts` :65-74, `components/renderers/*`), is replaced to `"production"` by the Console's build and stays live in the lib build for a consumer's bundler. Not a must-fix: five sibling dev warnings in core share the same leak, it is a console line and never a wrong draw, and the shim is the Console's; but this module is new and should take the idiom that gates. A card on the shim is the seat's call.
  - **should-fix (d) warn-once under StrictMode**: the Console mounts under `StrictMode` (its own tests say so), where every effect runs setup → cleanup → setup, so the "one warning" is two in development. The sibling `column-identity.ts` memoises on a module-level `Set` keyed by the message; the same here (keyed on `key` + address + names) makes the ruling's "once" literal and also quiets a remount.
- **`objectGridActionsColumn.tsx`** — holds; the `rowActions` plumbing to the plan and the menu props is removed in both places, `hasRowActions` no longer counts bare names, and `resolveLegacyRowActions` is still the type source for `resolvedRowActionDefs`. No finding.
- **`demo/bulk-actions.tsx`** — holds; the handler-only name and its `ActionProvider` handler are gone, the copy says what the bar does now. No finding.
- **Tests** — each flipped pin names the trigger (withheld action) in its body; the withheld/served describe is in the shared harness file as the ruling asked; fixtures declare what they name. One observation: both row-menu warning assertions read the spy synchronously after `openRowMenu` resolves, which holds because the harness awaits the menu, i.e. a render after the schema; fine as written.
- **Against the published spec on `main`**: the narrowing makes the spec's own refusal real at the consumer (the sentence at `bulk-action.zod.ts` :406 and lint's error) and takes no declared capability away: no key, value or export changes shape. Holds.

No must-fix. Should-fixes (a)-(d) are each a few lines in `ObjectGrid.tsx` / `undeclaredActionNames.ts` and do not block landing; the seat may fold them into a follow-up with the ListView card or push them on this branch before queueing (a new head would owe a fresh record).

**Check-runs on this head** (their conclusions are the gate verdicts, read after every run completed): `Type Check UI` success, `Test UI` success (all 16 shards), `Build & E2E UI` success, `Live E2E UI` success, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success, `Lint & Repo Gates` success, `TypeScript Type Check` success, `Test Core` success, `Check Changeset` success, `PR-body guards` success; `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, the Test Core shards and the dogfood shards were path-skipped. **`Lint UI` failure** — read at the step: the one red step is "Spec Liveness Check" (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness`), whose single UNANCHORED pair is `query/searchFields → packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`; that is main's red (anchor #30367, fix PR #30368, open at review time), not this diff's: the diff touches no file under `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/`, and the ledger's one `plugin-grid` citation (`key-mention.baseline.json` :65, `ObjectGrid.tsx`) is among the 1159 anchored pairs. Every other `Lint UI` step is green. The seat lands this only after `Lint UI` is green on a head that carries the main fix (`git merge origin/main` once #30368 lands; a new head owes a fresh record).

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `73d1535abc656c1e1447b3882875a123939238f9`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/undeclaredActionNames.ts, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/undeclaredActionNames.test.ts (new), ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/{objectBulkActionDispatch,bulkActionMembers-8071,legacyRowActionDispatch}.test.tsx + ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridRowLoad.ts (the row-load `catch`, :676-678), ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx (unchanged), ui/apps/console/index.html and ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts (the shim and the `define` the new pin models), ui/packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts and ui/packages/core/src/utils/column-identity.ts (the idioms adopted). Every other path of the PR is unchanged since the reviewed head and is covered by the record below.

**Delta review** of this seat's record on head `2f621a58` (PR comment 6654355327, PASS, no must-fix, should-fixes (a)-(d)). Since that head the branch carries exactly two commits, read from the ref: the merge `001b6173` (parents `2f621a58` and `origin/main` at `38717d34`, which carries #30368, the liveness fix; `git diff 2f621a58 001b6173 -- ui/packages/plugin-grid` is empty, so the merge brings nothing into the reviewed files), and the fix commit `73d1535a`, whose diff is the delta judged here: six files under `ui/packages/plugin-grid`, +244/-25. The changeset, README, demo, resolvers, `objectGridActionsColumn.tsx` and the package entry are byte-identical to the reviewed head. The judgments of the earlier record stand unchanged except where this one says otherwise.

### ① Derived judgments

Each should-fix against the tree:

- **(a) resolved `objectName` — closed.** `ObjectGrid.tsx` :1311-1319: readiness and the warning's address now read `objectName` (`resolveRecordSourceObjectName(schema, dataConfig) ?? schema.objectName`, :814), not `schema.objectName`. Pinned by the new row "an object named only through `data.object` waits for that object, and the warning names it" (`objectBulkActionDispatch.test.tsx`): the declared `push_down` draws and is not named, the address carries `objectName: 'os_prod_plan'`. Right.
- **(b) no hang, unread said as unread — closed on both load paths.** `objectSchemaAwaited = !!objectName && typeof dataSource?.getObjectSchema === 'function' && objectSchema == null && !objectSchemaReadFailed && error == null` mirrors `objectTypesPending` (:836): nothing is awaited with no object, no `getObjectSchema`, a landed schema, a failed inline read (new `objectSchemaReadFailed` state, set in the inline fetch's `catch` :1138 under the cancel guard) or a failed row load (`error`, which the non-inline `loadSchemaAndData` sets in its one `catch`, `objectGridRowLoad.ts` :676-678, and a schema read on that path throws inside the same `try`). `basis` is `'unread'` whenever an object is named and no schema is in hand, and `describeUndeclaredActionNames` then says the schema could not be read and prescribes a data source that answers `getObjectSchema`, not that the name is undeclared. Pinned by the `it.each` pair (no `getObjectSchema` / rejecting read → one warning containing "could not be read", both names, no button) and by the three unit rows in the new file. Right. One residual, not a finding: a grid whose `schema.filter` is refused never loads (`objectGridRowLoad.ts` returns before the `try`), so `objectSchemaAwaited` stays true and nothing is said; that grid renders the filter refusal and no bar, so there is nothing to report.
- **(c) production gate — closed.** `undeclaredActionNames.ts` :42 declares `process` module-scoped and :109-111 reads the literal `process.env.NODE_ENV`, the `@object-ui/fields` `resolveActionParams.ts` :65-74 idiom (the same packages' hosts already carry this literal in `@object-ui/components` renderers, so no host that runs them lacks a replaced or shimmed `process`). The pin (`undeclaredActionNames.test.ts`, `@vitest-environment node`) transforms the module with `transformWithOxc` under the Console's `define` plus `process.env.NODE_ENV: "production"` and asserts no `NODE_ENV` read survives and the gate folds to `"production" !== "production"`; that is the right place to pin it, since under vitest both spellings read node's own `NODE_ENV`. `vite` is a declared devDependency of the package; the file read is in-package through `new URL(rel, import.meta.url)`, a spelling `check:cross-package-test-inputs` knows. Right.
- **(d) warn once — closed.** A module-level `warnedMessages` Set keyed by the full message (key, address, names) with `resetUndeclaredActionNamesWarnings()` exported for tests; the three test files that count warnings reset it in `beforeEach`. Pinned under `React.StrictMode` and across an unmount/remount of the same list: exactly one warning. The memo shape is `column-identity.ts`'s. Right. Two grids with the same object, label and names on one page share one warning, which is the same sentence about the same fact.
- **Surface:** `resetUndeclaredActionNamesWarnings`, `UndeclaredActionNamesBasis` and the fourth `describeUndeclaredActionNames` parameter are new exports of the module, and the module is still imported only by `ObjectGrid.tsx`; `src/index.tsx` is unchanged, so the published surface of `@object-ui/plugin-grid` does not move. The `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` reading stands.
- **No new must-fix.** Break attempts on the delta: a declared name under the `data.object`-only shape (not reported, pinned); a schema that lands after a failed inline read (`objectSchema != null` wins, basis `'declared'`); a list whose names change after the first warning (the message differs, so it is said again, by design); the hooks still run in hook order before the first early return (:1316-1323 against the filter-refusal return at :1607). All hold.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from the reviewed head and still matching the tree: `.changeset/30169-undeclared-bulk-action-name-draws-nothing.md` byte-identical (`'@object-ui/plugin-grid': minor`, BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, prose remedy); `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` on the PR body and in the changeset; the four changesets the merge brings in belong to the merged main commits (#30368, #30298, #30351, #30353), not to this PR. The delta publishes nothing new: its exports stay inside an un-exported module, and the dev warning's wording is not a contract.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Should-fixes (a)-(d) of record 6654355327: each closed above with its pin named.
- The main-red of the earlier record (`Lint UI` on `check:liveness`, anchor #30367): the merge carries #30368, so this head is the one on which `Lint UI` can be green; see the gate line below.
- The plugin-list `ListView` non-grid bulk bar: still a follow-up card for the seat to file (unchanged judgment; not touched by the delta).
- No new deviation is reported for the delta; the fix commit carries the trailer pair.

### ④ Design judgment

- **`ObjectGrid.tsx`** — holds. The readiness predicate reads the same facts `objectTypesPending` reads plus the two failure signals, each of which is set exactly where the corresponding read fails and nowhere else; `objectSchemaReadFailed` is not cleared on a later successful read, which is harmless because a landed schema makes the predicate false on its own and the basis `'declared'`. The address now names the object the grid actually queries. No finding.
- **`undeclaredActionNames.ts`** — holds. The two message shapes share the rule line and differ only in what they assert about the object; the `'unread'` text does not claim a name is undeclared. The gate is the bundler-replaced literal with its reasoning in the module header. The memo is keyed on the message, so a changed list or a second list still reports. No finding.
- **Tests** — the new pins name their trigger in the body (the `data.object` shape, the two unread shapes, StrictMode + remount, the build fold); the `fails` leg deliberately does not wait for rows (masked columns under a failed read, objectui#10657) and waits on the warning instead, which is the observable it pins. No finding.
- **Against the published spec on `main`**: unchanged — the narrowing makes the spec's own refusal real at the consumer and withdraws no declared capability; the delta only changes when and how the audible half speaks.

No must-fix, no new should-fix.

**Check-runs on this head** (their conclusions are the gate verdicts, read after every run completed): every non-skipped check-run is `success`, 44 in all — `Lint UI` (now green: the merge carries #30368, so the `check:liveness` red of the earlier record is gone), `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` and all 16 shards, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint & Repo Gates` and its nine lanes, `TypeScript Type Check` and its four lanes, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards`, `Build UI Deps`, `Auto Label`, `filter`; `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, the Test Core shards, the dogfood shards and the opt-in harnesses were path-skipped. Nothing is red on this head.
